rows.adr_qualification: ADR previous US close vs newly available KR close; indicative mismatch, not current synchronized premium

live_iv_method.quality: calculated from provider current IV/Delta, not vendor constant-maturity endpoint
live_iv_method.25delta: linear interpolation of IV versus absolute delta within expiration; no extrapolation
live_iv_method.tenor: linear interpolation of total variance IV^2*T to fixed 7/30 calendar days; no extrapolation
live_iv_method.ATM: mean of Put/Call IV at same nearest common strike to previous stock close, per expiration

OI_method: snapshot OI refers to end of last completed session; observed on next calendar day, not available at prior close
volume_method: sum daily aggregate v across all 4168 contracts in as_of 2026-10-12 reference including expired; no near-ATM expiry restriction; no failed histories counted as zero

source_ratio.evidence: Each ADS represents one-tenth of a share of our common stock

ADR_method.timing: most recent KR close and completed FX hour before reference time; missing KR daily prices are not interpolated; asynchronous comparison

historical_IV: No official historical snapshot available; no current IV applied backwards.
